title: Saved settings
description:
Load and save settings through a storage object, surviving bad saved data.

```
load(storage)                   -> { theme: "light", fontSize: 14 }   (nothing saved yet)
save(storage, { theme: "dark" }) then load(storage) -> { theme: "dark", fontSize: 14 }
storage holds "{oops"           -> load gives the defaults again
```
hints: Wrap `JSON.parse` in `try` / `catch`; also check `typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null`.
Keep a key when `key in defaults && typeof value === typeof defaults[key]`.
requirements: `storage` has `getItem(key)` and `setItem(key, value)`, like `localStorage`. Use the key `"settings"`.
`load` merges what was saved over the defaults; broken JSON or a value that is not an object gives the defaults.
`save` stores only known keys with values of the right type.
stretch: Add a version number to the saved data and upgrade old saves that used `font` instead of `fontSize`.
